attrs.label: Devices
attrs.description:
The SCSI generic device nodes for your enclosures.</br>
Find them with: lsscsi -g | grep enclosu</br>
Eg: Host Device: /dev/sg16, Container Device: /dev/sg16

attrs.label: Host Device
attrs.description: The device node on the host.

attrs.label: Container Device
attrs.description: The device node inside the container. Normally the same as the host device.

attrs.label: Restrict to Enclosure IDs
attrs.description:
The enclosure logical identifiers to manage.</br>
Leave empty to manage every enclosure found.</br>
Find yours with: cat /sys/class/enclosure/*/id

attrs.label: Require a login
attrs.description:
Require an account to view the dashboard.</br>
When enabled, you create an administrator on first run.</br>
When disabled, anyone who can reach the port can read everything the
app can read, including the audit log and raw sg_ses output.

attrs.label: Allow Identify without a login
attrs.description:
Allow the Identify LED to be set without an account.</br>
Only applies when Require a login is disabled.

attrs.label: TrueNAS API Key
attrs.description:
Used for pool, vdev, ZFS error and SMART data.
Leave empty to run without it. The drive map, chassis telemetry and Identify all work without it.
Create one under Credentials -> Users: open the user and choose Access -> View API Keys and add a key, for a user with the Readonly Admin role.

attrs.label: TrueNAS Web Interface HTTPS Port
attrs.description: The HTTPS port of the TrueNAS web interface (System > General Settings > GUI).

attrs.label: Port Bind Mode
attrs.description:
The port bind mode.</br>
- Publish: The port will be published on the host for external access.</br>
- Expose: The port will be exposed for inter-container communication.</br>
- None: The port will not be exposed or published.</br>
Note: If the Dockerfile defines an EXPOSE directive,
the port will still be exposed for inter-container communication regardless of this setting.

1.0.3.readme:
KTN Enclosure Manager

KTN Enclosure Manager is a drive-bay map, chassis telemetry and IDENT LED control panel for SES disk shelves attached to TrueNAS SCALE. TrueNAS gates its built-in enclosure UI behind iX hardware, so a third-party shelf reports "Enclosure Unavailable"; this fills that gap without patching middleware. Telemetry uses read-only device opens, and the only write it can perform is lighting a drive bay's Identify LED.

⚠️ WARNING: This app requires a TrueNAS API key, which gives it administrative control over the system.

Misconfiguration or a malicious update can compromise data integrity, security, or system stability. Install at your own risk.
